name: Mirai
source:
A girl who gets to know Sota through a certain background. No
memory before hospitalization due to memory impairment. She blushes and speaks
politely, but she has a surprisingly friendly personality. She often spends time
with a cat named "Rin" who lives in a sanatorium.
